faq.answer: A rule-based chatbot follows scripts — fine for FAQs, useless for anything unexpected. An AI chatbot understands intent, handles follow-ups, pulls from your knowledge base, and escalates to humans when it is unsure. If your customers ask varied questions, AI wins. If they only need three fixed answers, you don't need us.
